title: Cabo Bachelorette Party: The IV Hangover Recovery Plan
description: Planning a bachelorette in Cabo? How group IV therapy works at your villa, when to book, costs ($119 per person for 6+, tax included) and a day-by-day plan.
h1: Cabo bachelorette party: the IV hangover recovery plan

intro: Cabo San Lucas is one of the most popular bachelorette and bachelor destinations for Americans — and a weekend of sun, boat days and late nights is exactly why group IV therapy has become part of the plan. Here is how it works, what it costs and how to schedule it so everyone feels great for the big night.

sections.h2: How group IV therapy works at your villa
p: Licensed nurses come to your villa, hotel suite, Airbnb or yacht with sealed, single-use IV sets and set up in the living room or by the pool. Everyone gets their drip at the same time, and the session usually takes about 45–60 minutes. You stay in your swimsuit, pajamas or sunglasses — no clinic, no taxi.

Groups of 6 or more pay $119 USD per person, tax included. Individual drips are $159–$189.99 + tax at your door. Nothing is charged in advance: we confirm the plan and total on WhatsApp and you pay at the visit. See the group IV page.
Travel days dehydrate everyone. A round of Rapid Hydration or Energy & B12 at the villa turns arrival day into night one.

h3.h: The morning after the big night
p: The most popular slot. Book Hangover Rescue for mid-morning so the group is back at the pool by lunch.

h3.h: Before the boat or the dinner
p: The Myers Cocktail or Beauty Glow is a favorite before photos and the main event.

list: Book as soon as you have dates — weekends and holidays fill first, and we schedule enough nurses for your group.
Send the villa address, number of people and the drip each person wants.
Pick a time and a shady, comfortable spot with chairs or sofas.
Eat something light beforehand and keep water nearby.
Anyone who is pregnant, on regular medication or has a medical condition should tell the nurse first.

p: “Bride and four bridesmaids did the drip the morning before the wedding. The photographer literally asked what we were using. Worth every dollar.” — Olivia C., Austin, TX

sections.h2: Book from the US before you fly
p: WhatsApp works with your US number: message +52 624 226 1023 with your dates and group size. More on booking before you arrive.

faq.q: How much is group IV therapy in Cabo?
faq.a: For groups of 6 or more at the same villa, hotel or yacht, IV drips are $119 USD per person, tax included.

faq.q: Can each person choose a different IV?
faq.a: Tell us which drip each person would like when you book, and we confirm the plan and total on WhatsApp before the visit.

faq.q: How far ahead should we book a bachelorette IV in Cabo?
faq.a: As soon as you know your dates, especially for weekends and holidays. Same-day group visits are often possible too.
Yes. We give IVs on board at the Marina in Cabo San Lucas before or after your charter.
